nvitk.pipes.qvtpy.util.eicab.morpho_topology¶

eICAB vessel-topology mapping for qvtpy stage-7 morphometrics.

Stage-7 still runs on eICAB TOF multilabel masks, so the topology source of truth is nvitk/measure/morpho/topology/eicab_topology.json (not the 4D-flow qvtpy_topology.json reference file).

Functions¶

build_eicab_topology_mapping(→ dict[int, ...)

Return label-id -> VesselInfo from eicab_topology.json.
